label: Physical Works
description:
A collection of functional morphologies and wearable artefacts investigating how identity is constructed and made physically legible through an altered body.

Using mutation as a shared visual logic, each artefact is a translation of transformative states into forms, producing an identity that can be physically interpreted from the outside.

Developed through an exchange between digital modelling and material experimentation, the artefacts are realised through 3D printing, casting, and hybrid fabrication.
